findings.detail: If git emits the main worktree record and then exits nonzero before listing another live worktree, live_worktrees_json accepts the truncated inventory. The omitted holder becomes stale, so check reports its resource free, claim can replace it without takeover approval, and prune can delete it. This defect predates the range; its previously reported Important severity is retained.
findings.evidence: The process substitution at line 230 does not expose git's exit status. Any emitted field sets saw_any=1, after which the final jq can succeed. decorate_claims then sets live_known=yes and marks absent holders stale; cmd_claim permits replacing stale holders, and cmd_prune removes stale claims. The base contains the same logic. The launcher's worktree_path_for_branch instead captures and checks the inventory command's status.
findings.title: Absent or partial data: failed worktree inventory can release live resource claims

findings.detail: The single-issue validator accepts concatenated JSON objects. Input containing {"number":1,"title":"One","state":"OPEN"} followed by {"number":2,"title":"Two","state":"OPEN"} produces a malformed single-issue prompt with combined numbers and titles while returning success. This defect predates the range; its previously reported Important severity is retained.
findings.evidence: jq empty accepts a JSON stream, and jq -e 'type == "object"' succeeds for both objects. Every jq_value extraction processes both documents, making number equal to "1\n2" and title equal to "One\nTwo" before the single prompt printf. The base contains the same validation and extraction logic. The sibling read_claims validator explicitly counts documents and rejects multiple values.
findings.title: Validator gaps: concatenated issue objects pass the single-object validation

findings.detail: The unknown-argument test checks the diagnostic through tail but never checks the composer's failure status. A regression that prints the expected error and returns success still passes, although callers use composition failure to stop before launching. Several malformed-claim tests have the same gap. This test defect predates the range.
findings.evidence: Line 99 ends the pipeline with tail and the block has no expected nonzero exit code. Returning 0 after printing 'compose-issue-prompt: unexpected argument: --nope' therefore satisfies the snapshot. The malformed stored-field cases in manage-resource-claims.md likewise pipe claims list into tail without retaining its status. In contrast, claims_tail saves and returns the helper status, and launch-workmux.md explicitly exits with PIPESTATUS for filtered error cases.
findings.title: Tests that cannot fail: filtered error snapshots do not verify rejection statuses
